raw_response:
I will keep this small beans plot low-cost because 0.21 hectare does not justify buying much fertilizer on its own, and on legumes here I usually do better by using the manure I can manage and seed I know. I do watch what other farmers do, and most of us do not put much chemical fertilizer on beans unless we have extra cash, which I do not want to risk this season. I will plant improved seed if I can get a small pack, because even on a small plot that can help, but I will not irrigate and I will not spend money on chemicals unless pests become very bad.
